name: Vigil
author: Jeffiest
description: Souls-lite combat for the story game, first prototype (S1). L2 evades (a roll, or a backstep at rest) spend the weapon gauge, so stamina gates them. Enemies hit harder, and a hit stuns you for less time and so protects you for less. Toan gains a heavy attack, combo finishers and lunges. Enemies with a brain circle you, track you through a wind-up, feint, punish a whiffed swing and take turns attacking. Holding the guard slows the gauge's recovery. See VIGIL_PLAN.md.
